hero.tagline: React, Next.js, PHP and Laravel. Valencia.

paragraphs: During my internship at Burguet Sistemas, I worked with another developer on a desktop app for managing a car park. I also extended the company intranet with React, PHP and MySQL.
I've built three projects with public source code: a platform for restaurants, a CRM for photo and video studios, and my own photography archive.
I use AI as a development tool and verify the code with tests. I also published Premium Frontend Director, an open-source skill for improving interface design with coding agents.

skillsSummary: I work across the interface, the API and database design. I use version control and tests to review changes.

featured.description: Customers can browse the menu, place an order and book a table. Staff run the restaurant through separate dashboards for the dining room, kitchen and administration.
featured.alt: Distrito Gourmet: home page with access to the menu and reservations

featured.description: One place for a photo or video studio's workflow, from quotes and session planning to invoices and delivery through a private gallery. Includes a local AI assistant.
featured.alt: LumaFlow Studio: screenshot of the application interface

featured.description: My photography archive, arranged into series you can filter and browse one image at a time. I generate the pages statically with Next.js.
featured.alt: raw.vives: home page of the photo archive
